[[Byzzr's Benediction]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Byzzr Wingmender]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Melandru's Hope]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Replica==
An exact replica of this item is a [[Divine Symbol (loop)|Divine Symbol]] from collector [[Olujime]].


It is possible to create an exact replica of this item with:
*[[Divine Symbol]] from collector [[Jwup]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Serenity Now]]" inscription
OR
*[[Divine Symbol]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Fortitude]].
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Serenity Now]]" inscription
